why: I ran onceTag over every ability in all 6 lists. Branch 1 copies a BSData tag that starts "Once/Twice per" and drops the " · …" suffix, e.g. Bomb Squig "Once per turn, twice per battle, per unit", Supreme Kunnin’ "Once per phase, per army", Twisted Sorceries "Once per battle · Psychic" → "Once per battle". Branch 2 copies the text’s own words: a leading "Once per turn" (Harpoon Barbs, Malign Presence) or a parenthesised "(Once per battle, per army)" (Archslaughterer, Umbralefic Crystal). It adds ", per army" only when the text says "one model from your army with this ability" (Will of the Hive Mind → "Once per battle round, per army"; BSData tags the same wording on Direct the Slaughter "Once per battle round, per army"). No limit is invented. Latent gaps, and they leave text out rather than add to it, so this stays ok: an unparenthesised "Once per battle" after a "… model only." sentence gets no tag (enhancements Incandaeum and Null Nodules, neither in any list), and a tag-less text "Once per turn, twice per battle, …" would be cut to "Once per turn". Bomb Squig has its tag, so it is not affected.

I tested perBattle on every ability, army rule, detachment rule, enhancement and stratagem in data.js:
- Bomb Squig "Once per turn, twice per battle, per unit" → n 2, per unit.
- Makari "Once per battle, per army" and Archslaughterer, Umbralefic Crystal, Morgog’s Finkin’ Cap, Mysterious Guardian "(Once per battle, per army)" → n 1, army.
- Protean Purpose "(Once per battle, per unit)" → n 1, per unit.
- Possessed Lord, Twisted Sorceries, Resilient Organism ("this model"), Fix Dat Armour Up and Boss’ Ammo Runt ("Once per battle, per unit") → n 1, per unit.
- Every "once per battle round" text gives null: Direct the Slaughter, Will of the Hive Mind, Intimidating Motivation, Keep Huntin’ and Blessings of Khorne "activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round".
- Insane Bravery "cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle" → 1.
Per-turn and per-phase limits are never counted. Note for the caller: the armyWide=true argument overrides an explicit "per unit" (perBattle(Higher Imperatives, true).army is true). That is where the screenPregame problem below comes from; with the argument omitted, perBattle itself reads "per unit" correctly.

A "per army" result gives one set keyed 'a:'+name, shared by every unit with the ability (Makari, Archslaughterer, Umbralefic Crystal: 1 box). Otherwise it gives one set per unit copy: Tyrannofex ×2 Resilient Organism → "Unit 1"/"Unit 2" with 1 box each; the two Mek units’ Bomb Squig → 2 boxes each, matching "twice per battle, per unit". Each Norn unit’s Protean Purpose → 1 box. An ability with an na reason, or with no per-battle limit, gets nothing. The keys are the same ones screenPregame uses (copyKey), so ticking stays in sync. No counting beyond the words.

grantSource returns the named ability on that same unit with its stored who/tag and text. If there is none, it returns the army, detachment or core rule that ruleFor finds, with its name, source, text and table. If nothing is found it shows only the name and no text, so nothing is made up. Every name in the w.from/s.from marks of all 6 lists resolves to an ability of that unit or a detachment rule of that list (Relentless Rage → Berzerker Warband, Dakka! Dakka! Dakka! → Shoota Boyz). No fallback is hit.

The popup holds only: "Granted by <names joined with and>"; the value label as the subtitle ("A 10", or the keyword); each named rule’s stored text and table; the note "Already in the value shown / keywords shown (as New Recruit and BSData list it/them)"; and the keyword’s own rule. bsdata.json reports 0 failures (103 grants compared in both directions); nr.json reports 0 failures (values and keywords compared cell by cell; every NR "(…)" name is among the marks). So the note is a checked fact.
I spot-checked every mark in data.js against its rule text, and each one grants that value to that weapon in that list:
- Relentless Rage "Friendly WORLD EATERS units’ melee attacks have +1 A": A on every hurrdurr melee weapon; all units are Faction: World Eaters.
- Berzerker Glaive "+1 A and D … melee weapons (excluding Extra Attacks weapons) equipped by the bearer": Daemon Prince strike/sweep, which have no EXTRA ATTACKS.
- Kustom Dakka "This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]": Mek plus Tankbustas/Flash Gitz ranged weapons, which form one attached unit per 19.04.
- Dakka! Dakka! Dakka! "Friendly ORKS INFANTRY units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]": only INFANTRY units (Big Mek, Warboss, Mek units, Gretchin). The conditional "+3\" R" is not marked.
- Supa-snazz Dakka "Snazzgun weapons have [RAPID FIRE 1]": only group Snazzgun (Cutta, Dakka, Kill Shot).
- Empyric Guidance "While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have [LETHAL HITS]": both led units, including the leader, per 19.04 "apply to every model in an attached unit".
- Icon of Flame "(excluding CHARACTERS)": Rubric Marines’ Malefic Curse and soulreaper only.
- More Dakka: IGNORES COVER only; SUSTAINED HITS 1 "if riled up" is not marked.
- Also correct: Nazdreg’s Know-wotz, Supa-glowy Fing, Brutal But Kunnin’, Cybork Boosta, Aggressive Advance (M 10" while leading), Eldritch Vortex (PSYCHIC weapons S and D), Synaptoprescience (4+ InSv), Destabilising Predation (ANTI-CHARACTER 2+).
No wrong mark found.

PROBLEM, "Uses per battle → Rules": onceRules takes every detachment rule with a per-battle phrase, and ruleTicks calls perBattle(r, true), which forces army. It then draws ticks('r:'+name, n) and ignores pb.army anyway. Higher Imperatives (Talons of the Norn Queen, in the nidzillas list) says only that NORN EMISSARY/NORN ASSIMILATOR units have Protean Purpose "(Once per battle, per unit)". Input nidzillas → output: a Rules line "Higher Imperatives · Talons of the Norn Queen" with ONE army-wide box (verify/out/snapshots/nidzillas.txt). The four Norn units’ own Protean Purpose lines under Abilities already get 1 box each, which is correct. The extra box is a count the words don’t give: per army instead of per unit, on top of the per-unit boxes. Code change needed: in both onceRules filters (army rules and detachment rules), leave out a rule whose per-battle limit is scoped per unit, e.g. add && !/per battle\b(?! round)[^.)]*\bper unit\b/i.test(r.text). Its uses are then counted only on the units’ ability rows. At minimum, don’t force armyWide for such a rule. The rest of the section matches its rules: Kindred Sorcery "select each of these abilities once per battle" → 1 box per option; Shadow in the Warp, War Cry and Insane Bravery → 1 box for the army.
Rest checked, ok:
- Reserves line against 20.01 "cannot exceed 50% of your points limit … (including those embarked within TRANSPORTS…)" and 20.03 "Unless otherwise stated … from the second battle round onwards"; "end of the third battle round … destroyed", with both exceptions. It leaves out "(excluding FORTIFICATIONS)", but no list has one.
- Deep Strike and Scouts lists follow "if every model in this unit has this ability" via partialRules (Slaughterbound left out of Scouts).
- Transports (Rhino capacity text); "start of the first battle round" (Singular Purpose); "start of the battle round" (Da Boss, Blessings of Khorne, Unearthly Power); Read Mission Objectives (Code Chivalric); Warlord, enhancements and attachments are list facts.
Latent, no wrong output today: (a) "^infiltrators" in the Scouts row and "infiltrat" in PREGAME_RE apply Scouts’ every-model condition and pre-battle timing to an Infiltrators rule with no text in D.rules. Remove them, or add that rule’s text.
